name: io.github.jefboneta/sensortensor
description: Search Pi developer API documentation. Agent feedback helps identify documentation gaps.

environment_variables.name: SENSORTENSOR_BASE_URL
environment_variables.description: Base URL of the Pi documentation API. It must expose /health, /openapi.json and /search. Example: https://api.sensortensor.world

environment_variables.name: SENSORTENSOR_API_KEY
environment_variables.description: Optional bearer token for API endpoints that require authentication, including shared feedback endpoints.

environment_variables.name: SENSORTENSOR_DATA_DIR
environment_variables.description: Directory for local feedback logs. Defaults to ./sensortensor_data.

environment_variables.name: SENSORTENSOR_AGENT_ID
environment_variables.description: Optional identifier for this agent in shared knowledge-gap reports.

environment_variables.name: SENSORTENSOR_SHARE
environment_variables.description: Sharing is disabled by default. Set to 1 to opt into sharing searches and feedback with the central API.
